name: Sunlit Kitchen Table Hunt
description: A warm wooden kitchen table in morning light with a glossy red mug, three bright oranges, a set of keys with fob, a blue striped cloth, a kraft notebook, and a leafy potted plant in a blue-white ceramic pot, with a wooden chair draped with a knit throw and a bright window in the background.
